family: The one total certificate-prefix language specified in proof.md and family.py. At actual length N compute c=(27+18sqrt(2))/64 and the least positive B with B^5>c*N^3 by exact g=64B^5-27N^3>0 and g^2>648N^6. Let p be the least prime at least B. Inspect every prime k in [p,2p] with k<N; compute m=N-k,r=ceil(m/k),t=ceil(sqrt(r)),d=d_joint from the theorem. Eligible means t<r,k>r+1,2k>=t(t+1),3<=d<=m. Choose the lexicographically least (3k+8d-7,k), or output0 if N=0 or no eligible candidate. Read the first selected k bits as lower coefficients of monic degree-k Q, reject invalid Q by the exact Frobenius/gcd test, and evaluate the descending-power BK symmetric polynomial on the remaining m bits with zero padding into r blocks. Output is the constant coefficient in F_2[Z]/Q. All prefix bits are counted in N; Q is input, not advice.
theorem: For the ONE fixed total uniform polynomial-time certificate-prefix family and exact prime-certificate minimization rule in family.py, C_B2(F_N)>=4N-R_N at every sufficiently large integer N, where R_N=3k+8d_N-7 and d_N is the exact joint-selection integer threshold in proof.md Section5 and family.py certified_dimension. All selected tuples satisfy the eligibility guards, and an eligible tuple exists at every sufficiently large integer length. The complete disperser proof needs only prime k>r+1 and k>=t(t+1)/2; eventually d_N=1+W+A0 with W=r(r+3)/2, H=(t-1)(t+2)/2, A0=(t-1)k-H-(r-t+1), k=Theta(N^(3/5)), and d_N=O(N^(4/5)). Every prefix bit is eventually essential and fixing an accepted prefix with nonconstant residual removes at least k gates in the strengthened signed-wire/output-literal model. The generic additive-seven theorem for d>=3 uses exactly the four R84 refutations and complete Q7 coverage executed by audit.py, with full normalization and unrestricted-sharing transfer supplied. For this SAME fixed family R_N/N^(4/5)->10*2^(1/5). Thus for every epsilon>0, C_B2(F_N)>=4N-(10*2^(1/5)+epsilon)*N^(4/5) for every sufficiently large integer N, and liminf C_B2(F_N)/N>=4. The exact limit concerns the explicit certificate remainder, not optimal circuit complexity. The proof states the classical PNT pi(x)~x/log(x), sources that standard premise and derives all relative-prime-gap corollaries; no conjecture is used. All field, uniformity, prefix, dispersion, gate, selection and all-length arguments are supplied.
